reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 4 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Thunder (revenge).
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 58 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.
